default.description: Env name used when `cce` is invoked without -e/--env. null or empty means no injection.

args.description: Global default claude args (shell-tokenized string). Prepended to every claude launch unless a per-env entry has `argsOverride: true`, or the user passes -A on the CLI. Example: "--permission-mode bypassPermissions"

env.description: Environment variables to inject into the claude child process. Matches the shape of Claude Code's settings.json `env` block, so values can be copy-pasted directly. Values may contain ${VAR} placeholders resolved from the parent shell env.

args.description: Per-env default claude args (shell-tokenized string). By default merged onto the global `args`; set `argsOverride: true` to replace the global args instead.

argsOverride.description: If true, this env's `args` replace the global `args` entirely. If false (default), they are merged onto the global args (pure concatenation).
